scripts.review: Original implementation reviewed: exact JSON endpoints; pass-through on unknown shapes/errors; no external requests, storage, logging, authentication or payment edits. Synthetic fixtures only; iOS not verified.

archives.review: Original implementation reviewed: exact JSON endpoints for Bilibili, Zhihu and Weibo feeds; Weibo removes only posts labelled 广告/热推, promotion.type "ad", recommend_video_card groups and the ad/advertises arrays; pass-through on unknown shapes/errors (code / error_code / errno); no external requests, storage, logging, authentication or payment edits. Synthetic fixtures only; iOS not verified. Withdrawn 2026-10-22: after Weibo API decryption was added, Weibo profile and post pages stopped opening on the device; kept for modules cached in between.

third_party.review: Reviewed 2026-10-22 (minified bundle). Decodes YouTube protobuf responses on youtubei.googleapis.com and removes ad entries and the Premium upsell tab. The multi-client adapter defines $httpClient/$task.fetch but no code calls it, so the script makes no network requests. $persistentStore holds only its ad-detection cache and settings; the only notification is a local "script needs update" message. Request headers are read only to tell YouTube Music apart. Any byte change requires a new review.
